title: Misty Hills of Munnar
shortDescription: Kerala is just the place where everything feels rejuvenating right from the start of your expedition.
description: Kerala is just the place where everything feels rejuvenating right from the start of your expedition. An amalgamation of rolling tea gardens, hills draped in mist, spice plantations, outcrops of forests and traditional cultural experiences. This trip leads you from the serenity of Munnar to the wildlife of Thekkady and ends with a unique touch of culture. Daily experiences like scenic drives through the Western Ghats, laughter at lakes and national parks, spice gardens with aromatic plants and traditional performances rooted in Kerala add layers to each day.

You will bask in the mountains, embark on cultural experiences and go on easy-going picnics, all at your pace. This Kerala getaway is a well-paced, comfortable sojourn to one of the southern end's most beautiful places on earth.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Cochin – Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.description: Arrival at Cochin – Transfer to Munnar. Enjoy a scenic drive through the beautiful landscapes of the Western Ghats surrounded by valleys, tea plantations, and spice-scented hills. Learn about Munnar, a popular hill station located at the confluence of three mountain streams and known for its lush greenery and cool climate. Upon arrival, check into the hotel or resort and relax amidst the peaceful surroundings.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a sightseeing tour of Munnar. Visit the scenic Mattupetty Dam, known for its panoramic hill views and calm surroundings. Continue to Kundala Lake, where guests can enjoy boating and admire the beauty of the surrounding forests and mountains. Stop at the famous Echo Point and enjoy the natural echo phenomenon amidst the hills. Drive through the rolling tea plantations that define the charm of Munnar. Guests may also visit Eravikulam National Park, home to the endangered Nilgiri tahr. (subject to seasonal availability and park timings). Optional activities including tea factory visits, jeep rides, and elephant rides can also be enjoyed. Return to the hotel after sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Munnar – Thekkady
itinerary.description: After breakfast, begin the journey towards Thekkady with en route sightseeing. Visit the scenic Photo Point, one of Munnar’s most photographed locations surrounded by tea gardens and hills. Continue to a traditional spice garden and explore plantations growing cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, medicinal herbs, and fruit-bearing trees while learning about Kerala’s spice heritage. Later, enjoy a live Kalaripayattu performance in Thekkady showcasing the ancient martial art form known for its agility, combat techniques, and acrobatic movements. Proceed to Thekkady and check into the hotel.

itinerary.title: Thekkady Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for local sightseeing in Thekkady. Visit the famous Periyar National Park, known for its rich biodiversity, dense forests, and wildlife habitats spread across the Cardamom Hills. Later, visit the Navarasa Kathakali Centre to witness traditional Kathakali dance performances and cultural storytelling inspired by Indian epics. Guests can also enjoy demonstrations of Kalaripayattu martial arts during the cultural experience. Return to the hotel after sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Cochin Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the resort and drive to Cochin Airport or railway station.
